epics.title: HAIL Production ATO
epics.description: Initiate and complete the Authority to Operate (ATO) process for HAIL to unblock production deployment for FY26-27.

phases.title: Draft HAIL-to-Production ADR
phases.description: Document the architecture decision record for moving HAIL to production, including risk assessment and mitigations.
subtasks: Identify ATO requirements from CIO security team
Draft ADR using standard HC/PHAC template

phases.title: CIO Briefing Package
phases.description: Prepare executive briefing material summarising HAIL's current state, ATO path, and governance gaps.
subtasks: Map to protected B classification bands

phases.title: Security Assessment (SA&A)
phases.description: Formal Security Assessment and Authorisation engagement with CIO security office.

phases.title: ATO Sign-off
phases.description: Obtain written ATO from CIO authorising production operation of HAIL.

phases.title: Production Cutover Plan
phases.description: Define runbook for promoting HAIL from runtime-only to full production, including rollback procedures.

epics.title: PATH / HAIL Convergence Architecture
epics.description: Define and validate the architectural convergence between PATH (control plane) and HAIL (runtime), resolving the undefined interface gap.

phases.title: Interface Contract Design
phases.description: Document the API and event contracts between PATH gateway and HAIL execution layer.

phases.title: GREP-ExP Pattern Validation
phases.description: Validate the Govern → Route → Execute → Promote pattern across PATH and HAIL boundaries.

phases.title: ARB Submission — Convergence ADR
phases.description: Submit convergence architecture decision record to Architecture Review Board.

phases.title: Reference Architecture Update
phases.description: Update the PATH reference architecture page and diagrams to reflect convergence state.

phases.title: Integration Smoke Test
phases.description: Run end-to-end token flow test from PATH gateway through HAIL execution layer.

epics.title: Shadow AI Exposure Controls
epics.description: Quantify and mitigate unsanctioned AI tool usage (CANChat, Copilot, public ChatGPT) across HC/PHAC, reducing Protected B data handling risk.

phases.title: Shadow AI Inventory
phases.description: Enumerate known shadow AI touchpoints and estimate user populations.

phases.title: Data Handling Risk Assessment
phases.description: Assess risk of Protected B data being transmitted to non-approved AI services.
subtasks: Classify data types in known workflows
Map to AI tool data retention policies

phases.title: Acceptable Use Policy Update
phases.description: Draft AI acceptable use policy addendum covering shadow AI, approved platforms, and classification constraints.

phases.title: Automated Detection Capability
phases.description: Evaluate tooling options for detecting unsanctioned AI tool traffic at the network perimeter.
subtasks: Proof of concept for one tool

epics.title: Governance Intelligence Platform
epics.description: Mature the EA intelligence page into a sustainable living-document platform with structured update workflows, versioning, and local LLM review.

phases.title: Intelligence Editor — Core
phases.description: Markdown editor with live preview, draft persistence, and GitHub publish flow.

phases.title: Local LLM Analyzer
phases.description: Browser-based DistilBERT/DistilBART inference for privacy-compliant content review.

phases.title: File Import Feature
phases.description: Allow users to import .txt, .md, and image files into the editor for LLM-assisted analysis.

phases.title: Compliance Validation
phases.description: Formally validate local LLM workflow for Protected B data handling with Privacy Office.

phases.title: Expanded Model Coverage
phases.description: Evaluate larger local models (Llama 3, Mistral 7B) for improved analysis quality where compute allows.

epics.title: Vendor Assessment Workbench
epics.description: Build out the platform assessment comparison tooling to support procurement decisions with structured rubric scoring.

phases.title: Four-Layer Rubric Implementation
phases.description: Implement the HC/PHAC governance, architecture, capability, and procurement scoring rubric.

phases.title: Vendor Data — Initial Set
phases.description: Populate assessment JSON for Anthropic, OpenAI, Gemini, Cohere, and GC LLM.

phases.title: Compare Workbench UI
phases.description: Side-by-side vendor comparison interface with filtering and radar chart visualisation.

phases.title: Assessment Refresh — Q2 2026
phases.description: Update all vendor assessments to reflect Q2 2026 capability and governance changes.
